item.title: Show HN: Things to Do API (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: I built an api/mcp for local events: pop-ups, one-off events, concerts, etc. currently covering the SF bay area. I've been building a bunch of consumer apps lately around personalization and recommendation and have had a hard time finding this data in one spot. agents can find useful stuff through tool calls / web search, but slow. you can scrape on demand too, but i wanted a faster data set and couldn't find an existing provider for the mix of event types I was searching for. the methodology for it is to find influential accounts/posters/etc. and do a fan out across things that they co-post with. mcp: `claude mcp add --transport http thingstodo https://api.thingstodoapi.com/mcp` I'm considering adding other cities. If you're building something that needs local event data, would something like this be useful and where would you want coverage? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50126384 Points: 2 # Comments: 0

item.title: Show HN: Fakeipedia - Wikipedia for worlds that don't exist (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hi HN! Fakeipedia is an automatic world-building platform which takes an imagined world and makes a whole wiki that you can endlessly explore by clicking red links. I came up with this idea a few months ago after playing around with worldbuilding in Gemini, but I didn't want to release it until a powerful enough model could do it justice, and I decided that Argon is creative enough to write articles that are worth reading. I was surprised how well it turned out and how engaging some of the writing actually is. If you want to generate an article there is a nominal charge attached ($0.90), which helps cover AI/Stripe costs, and I think I just about break even. You can also steer the generation ala choose-your-own-adventure books when generating a new article. Everything generated is free and public for everyone to see. I hope you like it and I'm very much open to hearing about new world ideas/features that would make this project better. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50126334 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
